demo.program:
# Prolog — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created Prolog?", "Alain Colmerauer"),
    ("What paradigm is Prolog?", "logic"),
    ("What is creator?", "Alain Colmerauer"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "1972"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "logic"),
    ("What is typing?", "dynamic"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".pl"),
    ("What is hello world?", ":- write('Hello, world!'), nl."),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
